name: Friedman
description: This striking completely renovated Manhattan duplex featured natural products including Mahogany wood paneling, unique multicolored glass work, stone floors and tinted Venetian plaster.

name: Feldschuh
description: Raw loft space in the heart of Soho, this loft embraces an eclectic and sophisticated fashion statement with a New York attitude. This renovation for Michael Feldusch included a flawless restoration of landmark antique wood windows and a pain-staking restoration of a richly textured tin set ceiling. Showing the restored existing wood floor and columns and keeping the historic beauty of the building while minimally impacting the environment.

name: Biggio
description: Innovation and complete renovation transformed this unit in a 1900 building into a unique, contemporary luxury residence. Two loft floors and a terrace were merged into a duplex unit with a penthouse, connected by a hand-made maple staircase. Due to the space contrast and the addition of an ingenious maple louver system and magnificent architectural woodwork with a custom satin stain finish, this residence truly has a personality of its own.

name: Danny & Victor
description: The transformation of this spectacular kitchen with character and individuality, custom wood cabinetry and onyx tiles.

name: Friemann
description: This estate sale, three bedroom apartment with 600 square feet of terrace space was transformed for Nairn Friemann from dreary to spectacular. Tribeca meets Sutton Place in this totally renovated open plan, penthouse quality home. Lacquer finish in cool colors and unique glasswork contrast with mahogany floors and copper slate. Contemporary design combined with country furnishings, creates an eclectic environment with high style and home comfort.

name: Goedhuis
description: Passionate transformation, exceptional taste. Cherry custom cabinetry, custom wood libraries, restoration of wood floors, frames, doors and Jerusalem stones tiles for the bathrooms.

name: Kitchen
description: Enlightened spacious love-filled home. The complete renovation of a loft space for Robert Kitchen in SoHo, where art and everyday life are inextricably linked. This stylish 5,000 square foot location is highlighted by a Bohemian-style hallway combining slate and wood. In addition, the bath is a masterpiece of remarkable tile work, including travertine floor tiles with inserts of onyx and French stone and hand-made clay wall tiles with glass inserts.

name: Miles
description: Guided by divine of the project and identity of the clients. We transformed an early 20th century loft in the heart of tribeca. It was one open space with one bedroom converted into two bedrooms with an open living room where the sun shine flow. Flawless restoration, cherry wood cabinetry, concrete counter-tops, custom marble rain shower with a custom designed drainage. “Honor the past marble reflect the soul of timeless nature.” Restoration of the wood floor, the result is a beautiful work that delights senses and engaged mind.

name: Myerberg
description: Environment and soul, bright and welcoming. In this quintessential Greenwich Village residence, a calm ambience has been achieved through a remarkable renovation for Marcia Myerberg. This is a home of high style and perfection, featuring one-of-a-kind custom millwork with white lacquer finish and hand-crafted limestone.

name: Richardson
description: The transformation of this spectacular loft renovation took 18 months, during which we spent 12-hour days at the site working alongside our client, John Richardson, while he was writing A Life of Picasso, Volume II.

name: Rosenberg
description: Soulful renovation is a loft that combines originality with luxury and connecting you with your inner nature. The complete apartment floor is made of bamboo which is sustainable and environmentally friendly. All the living room walls are made of hand pick English sycamore with a hand polish finish. Located in a monumental late 1800s building in Tribeca, this loft was completely rehabilitated for combining two lofts. Now a vivid clash of past and future, the loft contrasts antique walls with semicircular English sycamore panels, marvelous custom kitchen cabinets, exotic bamboo floors and hand-made tiles. This home is an unquestionable work of art.

name: Stanwick
description: Dazzling renovation. This complete renovation featured mahogany wood and utilized every corner in this apartment for storage. This creative use of space makes for very efficient and environmentally conscious living.

name: Swinehart
description: Featured in the Tribeca Loft Tour 2006, this 3000 sqft family loft creates overlapping zones of shared living while partitioning off private bedrooms as in an apartment. The common space is open and spacious. Light from large uninhibited windows reveal city views and bring natural light to the common space. The restored exposed brick wall and wooden floors combine with shades of white, silver and grey to create a clean, subtle, minimalist ambiance. Vast storage space is gently integrated into the background and wide open walls reserve space for hanging art. Metallic exteriors, sleek cabinetry and marble surfaces put a refined touch of elegance on a practical living space.

name: Trump
description: The breathtaking view from this Columbus Circle apartment is matched by the glamour of the superlative interior. This exquisite renovation for Dane Tyler features a sleek wall paneling system crafted from macassar ebony, tailored architectural millwork with gold and silver leaf inserts and fine kitchen cabinetry with an elegant polyester finish.
